reports.summary: Day 1 of the official verification window. Revenue remains ¥0. Among today's several events, the most important was an AI diagnostic error and its correction: during a full channel inventory, the AI wrongly equated 'no record in the GitHub repo' with 'the Gumroad/Creem accounts don't exist.' The owner corrected this directly — both accounts are actually open with KYC and bank setup done (Gumroad fully ready; Creem last known under review) — the human had done this work, it just hadn't been migrated into the GitHub source of truth. On the corrected facts, re-evaluation (using live WebSearch/WebFetch, not guesswork) found Gumroad's technical path is genuinely lower-friction than Etsy's (a single access token via an official CLI), so the AI built a parallel Gumroad publish pipeline alongside Etsy's. Creem stays un-built (duplicates Stripe's role). Other events today: a scheduled cadence run, reclassifying STRIPE_RESTRICTED_KEY/X credentials as optional, building the Etsy publish pipeline, a Browser/Computer-Use investigation, and Etsy OAuth spec verification. The two remaining blockers are the Etsy OAuth token grant and the Gumroad access-token grant.

reports.summary: Day 2 of the official verification window. Revenue remains ¥0. Nothing changed since yesterday, but rather than assume that, the AI actually triggered both the Etsy publish Action (etsy-publish.yml) and the Gumroad publish Action (gumroad-publish.yml) itself via GitHub MCP and read the real run results. Both jobs completed successfully, but each run's log explicitly says 'no-ops without credentials' — empirically confirming that neither the Etsy OAuth token nor GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN has been granted yet, rather than relying on an assumption carried over from yesterday. No open GitHub issues, no 'Promotion blocked' issue; main is at the same commit as this branch (c5113d9). The automated Stripe sales monitor's latest run (2026-09-02T04:35 UTC) also detected no new revenue (status/revenue_ledger.json is still empty). No new content or product was built this run — the two publish pipelines are confirmed technically ready and waiting only on the token grants, verified at near-zero cost (GitHub Actions' free tier) rather than assumed.

reports.summary: Day 3 of the official verification window. Revenue is still ¥0, but there was a real breakthrough: a product actually went live on Gumroad. The owner added GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN as a GitHub secret, and the AI triggered the gumroad-publish.yml Action itself. The first run failed with a real API error (`POST /v2/direct_uploads -> 400 content_type must be JPEG, PNG, GIF, or video`) -- that endpoint is for images/video, not the digital file. Using that exact error as evidence, the AI read Gumroad's actual production source (files_controller.rb) directly and corrected the flow to the right S3-multipart upload path (`/v2/files/presign` -> `/v2/files/complete`). The second run succeeded: the $9 'ChatGPT Prompts + AI Automation Toolkit' product is now live at https://feverish50.gumroad.com/l/uhajxo. This is not 'ready to publish' -- it's an actual listing a real third party can buy right now. No purchase has happened yet, and that distinction is being reported honestly, not blurred.

reports.summary: Day 4 of the official verification window. Revenue remains ¥0. The Etsy OAuth token is still not granted today, and a freshly re-triggered Action empirically re-confirmed this is still the only true blocker (not assumed carried over). Rather than stop at re-confirming that unchanged blocker, today's run found and fixed two real gaps on the already-live, non-blocked Gumroad lane: (1) the listing had no cover image (deliberately deferred at the original publish) -- read Gumroad's actual production source to find the correct upload path, then called the real API and confirmed the image attached successfully. (2) The live Gumroad listing had zero inbound links from any of the experiment's own pages -- added one from index.html (deliberately not from the $19 Stripe store page, to avoid steering visitors who are already mid-checkout toward the cheaper $9 Gumroad option and cannibalizing that lane). Also confirmed, from the Sales Monitor Action's real job logs, that the open question from 2026-09-03 about Gumroad sales detection (does the access token actually carry the view_sales scope?) is resolved: it does. No purchase has occurred yet.

reports.summary: Day 5 of the official verification window. A major milestone: all three digital-product channels -- Stripe, Gumroad, and Etsy -- are now simultaneously live and purchasable for the first time in this experiment. The owner fully completed the Etsy API v3 OAuth walkthrough (all 5 GitHub Actions secrets registered) and reported that Creem's review had passed. Two sessions ended up working the same Etsy problem in parallel today: one root-caused and fixed a 403 error (the Shared Secret requirement, identified as a genuine Etsy platform change effective Feb 9, 2026), merged it to main, then fixed a tag-length 400 error and achieved the first live Etsy listing (https://www.etsy.com/listing/4569271638, $9). The other (this session) independently investigated and was about to push its own fix for the identical 403 when a re-fetch of main surfaced the already-merged fix -- deferred to it rather than duplicating the work. An honest failure to record: this session's own idempotency-verification re-trigger (2026-09-05T01:01:46Z) fired while a real idempotency bug (a second state-save silently dropping the first call's listing_id) was still unfixed, and it genuinely created a duplicate Etsy listing (4569274006). The other session root-caused this immediately, restored the canonical listing record, and deactivated the duplicate. Also closed a stale 'Promotion blocked' GitHub issue. No purchase has occurred on any channel yet. LATER THE SAME DAY (owner-directed correction + the actual 20:07 JST scheduled cadence run): the owner corrected an overclaim from an intermediate session that had called the Etsy index.html backlink 'the' binding constraint -- real per-channel diagnostics (Etsy API views/favorers, Gumroad product fields, live Stripe checkout-session data) showed no channel with a differentiating real-inflow signal, so that conclusion was retracted. The owner then approved a 3-item priority list: Gumroad's confirmed 'Other' category defect was fixed to 'self-improvement/productivity' (verified via a live re-fetch); the Etsy re-diagnostic was deliberately deferred (listing too young, re-check gated to ~2026-09-06T00:55Z); Gumroad's view-count blind spot was traced to Gumroad's own session-cookie-gated dashboard controller and confirmed genuinely AI-unreachable, so exactly one low-priority human ask was queued. This evening's scheduled cadence run (20:10 JST) then re-confirmed, with fresh evidence, that nothing material had changed since: 0 live Stripe charges/checkout sessions (queried directly via Stripe MCP), 0 new Gumroad sales (latest sales-monitor Action run, 04:30 UTC), no open GitHub issues (no 'Promotion blocked'), and the Etsy re-diagnostic timing gate not yet reached. No economically rational action was available beyond what the owner-directed session already executed today, so this run stopped early per the loop's cost-control rule rather than manufacture busywork.
reports.summary_ja: 公式検証期間5日目。大きな節目：Stripe・Gumroad・Etsyの3つのデジタル商品チャネルすべてが、本実験で初めて同時に稼働・購入可能な状態になった。オーナーがEtsy API v3のOAuth手続きを完全に完了させ（5つ全てのGitHub Actions Secretsを登録）、Creemの審査も通過したと報告。この日、Etsyの同じ問題に対して2つのセッションが並行して取り組む状況が生じた：1つは403エラー（Shared Secret要件、2026年2月9日施行のEtsy側の仕様変更と特定）を根本原因から修正しmainへマージ、その後タグ長超過の400エラーも修正して初のEtsyリスティング公開（https://www.etsy.com/listing/4569271638、$9）に成功した。もう1つ（本セッション）は独立に同じ403エラーを調査・修正しかけたが、mainへの再フェッチで既にマージ済みの修正を発見し、重複実装を避けてそちらに合わせた。正直に記録すべき失敗もあった：本セッションが行った「べき等性の確認」目的の再起動（2026-09-05T01:01:46Z）が、当時はまだべき等性バグ（2回目の状態保存が1回目のlisting_idを消す）が未修正だったため、実際に重複出品（4569274006）を引き起こした。もう一方のセッションが直ちに原因を特定し、正規のリスティングへ記録を復元、重複分を無効化して収拾した。あわせて古い「Promotion blocked」issueをクローズした。まだどのチャネルでも購入は発生していない。同日後半（オーナーによる訂正、および実際の20:07 JST定時ループ実行）：中間セッションが『index.htmlのEtsy被リンクが真のボトルネックだ』と過大に断定していたことをオーナーが訂正——各チャネルの実データ（Etsy APIのviews/num_favorers、Gumroad商品フィールド、Stripeの実際のcheckout session)を見ると、いずれのチャネルにも差別化された実流入シグナルは無く、その結論は撤回された。オーナーは続けて3項目の優先実行リストを承認：Gumroadの確認済み『Other』カテゴリ欠陥を『self-improvement/productivity』へ修正（実際の再取得で検証済み）；Etsyの再診断はリスティングがまだ若すぎるため意図的に延期（再チェックは約2026-09-06T00:55Zまでゲート）；Gumroadの閲覧数データの空白は、Gumroad自身のセッションCookie保護されたダッシュボード用コントローラに起因すると特定し、AIからは本当に到達不可能であることを確認した上で、低優先度の人間向け依頼を1件のみ登録した。本日夕方の定時ループ実行（20:10 JST）は、新たな実証拠に基づき、それ以降に重要な変化が無いことを再確認した：Stripe MCPで直接確認したチャージ・checkout session 0件、直近のSales Monitor実行（UTC 04:30）による新規Gumroad売上0件、オープンなGitHub issueなし（『Promotion blocked』も無し）、Etsy再診断のタイミングゲートも未到達。本日オーナー主導セッションが既に実行した内容を超えて経済合理的な追加行動は無かったため、ループの費用抑制ルールに従い、無駄な作業を作らず早期終了した。

reports.summary: Day 6 of the official verification window, scheduled cadence run. No completed sale yet, but for the first time in the experiment, two channels showed non-zero real-inflow signals simultaneously. Stripe: a fresh live query (Stripe MCP) found 2 real checkout sessions, both created today (2026-09-06), status 'open'/payment_status 'unpaid', $19 each. Every prior check over the preceding 13 days had found 0 checkout sessions ever, so this is the first non-zero result on this channel. Etsy: the owner's Day-5 timing gate (re-diagnose only once the listing is genuinely 24-48h old) had passed, so the diagnostic was re-run -- views moved 0 -> 2 (num_favorers still 0). Given the Stripe movement, audited the store page and buy-button wiring for an actual defect that could explain the checkout abandonment; found none -- the 2 incomplete checkouts are more likely ordinary shopping behavior (comparison, hesitation) than a bug. However, the sample sizes are too small on both channels (n=2 each) to declare a 'winning' channel or to justify any price/product/resource-allocation change -- recorded the real observation honestly without repeating the premature overclaim pattern the owner corrected on Day 5. Also identified a real observability gap: no web analytics exist on index.html or /store/, so the source of the 2 Stripe visits is unrecoverable after the fact -- flagged as a future build candidate if repeat real traffic appears, not acted on this turn. Gumroad unchanged (0 sales, category fix holding). No open GitHub issues (no 'Promotion blocked'); main was already in sync with the branch.
reports.summary_ja: 公式検証期間6日目、定時ループの実行。実売上はまだ発生していないが、本実験で初めて2つのチャネルで同時に非ゼロの実流入シグナルが観測された。Stripe：本日のライブ照会（Stripe MCP）で、実在するcheckout sessionが2件見つかった（いずれも本日2026-09-06に作成、状態'open'・支払い状況'unpaid'、$19）。過去13日間、Stripeのcheckout sessionは常に0件だったため、これが本実験で初めての非ゼロ結果。Etsy：オーナーが5日目に設定した『リスティング公開から24〜48時間経過後に再診断する』というタイミングゲートが経過したため再実行したところ、views（閲覧数）が0→2へ動いた（num_favorersは0のまま）。この2つの動きを受け、Stripeストアページと購入ボタンの導線に、離脱を招くような実際の不具合がないか監査したが、見つからなかった——2件のcheckout未完了は単なる不具合ではなく、通常のショッピング行動（比較検討・離脱）である可能性が高い。ただし、サンプルサイズが小さすぎる（両チャネルともn=2）ため、いずれかのチャネルを『勝者』と断定したり、価格・商品構成・リソース配分を変更する根拠にはならない——オーナーが5日目に訂正した『時期尚早な過大断定』と同じ誤りを繰り返さないよう、今回は観測結果を正直に記録するにとどめた。あわせて、index.htmlや/store/にウェブ解析（アクセス解析）が一切無く、この2件のStripe訪問がどこから来たのか事後的に特定できないという、実在する観測ギャップも発見した——ただし今回は着手せず、今後反復的な実トラフィックが確認された場合の構築候補として記録するにとどめた。Gumroadは変化なし（売上0件、カテゴリ修正は維持）。オープンなGitHub issueは無く（Promotion blocked issueも無し）、mainブランチは既に最新のブランチ内容と同期済みだった。
